Scans built interface files (.html .htm .css .scss .jsx .tsx .vue .svelte) for the two copy and layout patterns DESIGN.md bans outright (eyebrow labels and kicker titles; the middle dot or bullet as an inline divider), and warns on all-caps text. It does not check design rules in general. Cannot detect: an app with none of the scanned file types passes with 0 files scanned.

Title, description, canonical and Open Graph tags present in the parsed document (not inside comments, scripts, styles or templates); robots.txt is text with a directive line and does not disallow everything for User-agent: *; sitemap.xml is XML with a urlset having a url/loc or a sitemapindex having a sitemap/loc. Not checked: noindex (meta robots or X-Robots-Tag) and a meta refresh or script redirect to another origin.
